title: Hoof It
description: Count hiking trails from trailheads to peaks on a topographic map.
writeup:
## Approach

A topographic map where each cell is a height 0–9. A valid trail starts at 0, ends at 9, and increases by exactly 1 each step (4-directional movement).

## Part 1

For each trailhead (height 0), BFS to find all reachable height-9 cells. The score is the number of *distinct* peaks reachable. Sum scores across all trailheads.

## Part 2

Now count the number of *distinct paths* to any peak, not just distinct peaks. The same BFS works — we simply don't deduplicate during traversal. Each time we reach a 9, that's one more trail. The BFS naturally explores all possible paths since we don't mark cells as visited.
